$comment: ArchiMate 3.1/3.2 -> 4 migration rules. `rename` covers concepts merged into the Common Domain (the original domain is kept in the `domain` property); `removed` covers the seven concepts dropped in ArchiMate 4.

BusinessInteraction.note: Interaction became a Process; the elements assigned to it are its participants. Review the assigned Collaboration.

ApplicationInteraction.note: Interaction became a Process; the elements assigned to it are its participants. Review the assigned Collaboration.

TechnologyInteraction.note: Interaction became a Process; the elements assigned to it are its participants. Review the assigned Collaboration.

Representation.note: Representation was removed. Mapped to Material; use Data Object or Artifact instead if it is digital.

Contract.note: Contract was removed and became a Business Object.

Constraint.note: Constraint was removed and became a Requirement.

Gap.note: Gap was removed and became an Assessment; keep it associated with the two Plateaus it compares.
